definition: a brown metal of copper and tin
description: In a dim brick foundry with wooden roof beams, a young man in safety glasses, a leather apron and heavy gloves tilts a long-handled crucible and pours glowing molten metal into a funnel on top of a sand-covered mould, as sparks fly. He lifts the crucible back and holds it still, and another man appears at the side. Beside them stands a life-size shiny bronze horse statue on a wooden base, and a bronze horse leg rises out of the sand in front. Old bells and ingots fill the shelves.

taps.phrase: to stand on a wooden base
